sources.name: RELAB - Brown University Reflectance Experiment Laboratory
sources.description: Laboratory reflectance spectral database (UV to mid-IR) of minerals, meteorites, lunar samples and analogues used to interpret remote-sensing spectra. Spectra are searchable and downloadable via the RELAB database page and are mirrored at the PDS Geosciences Node.

sources.name: Chang'e-1 / Chang'e-2 global lunar DOM and DEM
sources.description: Global image mosaics (digital orthophoto maps) and DEMs of the Moon from Chang'e-1 (120 m) and Chang'e-2 (7 m CCD stereo camera, partial) data, among the first Chinese lunar products released.

sources.name: Chang'e-4 / Yutu-2 data (CLPDS)
sources.description: Far-side Chang'e-4 lander and Yutu-2 rover data (terrain and panoramic cameras, VNIS spectra, lunar penetrating radar) at Von Karman crater, released via CLPDS. Registration is needed to download.

sources.name: Chang'e-5 and Chang'e-6 data (CLPDS)
sources.description: Chang'e-5 (2020, Oceanus Procellarum) and Chang'e-6 (2024, far-side South Pole-Aitken basin sample return) landing-site imagery, spectra and mineral analyser data released through CLPDS. Released in stages; check the portal for current availability.

sources.name: China Lunar and Planetary Data Release System (CLPDS)
sources.provider: National Astronomical Observatories, Chinese Academy of Sciences (NAOC) / Lunar and Deep Space Exploration Science Applications Center
sources.description: Official release system of the Chinese Lunar Exploration Program: Chang'e-1 to Chang'e-6 and Tianwen-1 data at levels 0-2, with orbital imagery, DEM, spectra and lander/rover products. The interface is Chinese and English; downloads generally require free registration.

sources.name: Tianwen-2 asteroid sample-return mission (CNSA)
sources.description: Chinese mission launched in 2025 to near-Earth asteroid Kamo'oalewa (469219) and later main-belt comet 311P. Imagery will appear on CNSA news pages and eventually in NAOC's release system; no public data archive yet.

sources.name: Catalog of Planetary Maps (ELTE)
sources.provider: Eotvos Lorand University (ELTE) Planetary Mapping Digital Museum
sources.description: Searchable catalogue of printed planetary maps and atlases from many countries and eras (including Soviet and Russian MIIGAiK maps), with scans and metadata for many entries. Historical cartography rather than raw sensor data.

sources.name: ESASky (solar system objects)
sources.description: Browser sky viewer with a solar-system-objects mode to find observations of planets, asteroids and comets by space observatories, overlaying many mission archives. Most useful for telescope observations of solar-system bodies.

sources.name: ESA Mars Express image releases
sources.description: ESA Mars Express mission page, linking to the processed Mars Express images and videos published by ESA, mostly HRSC colour mosaics, anaglyphs and perspective views of named Martian features. Outreach quality; the scientific data are in the PSA.

sources.name: ExoMars TGO: CaSSIS, NOMAD, ACS, FREND (PSA)
sources.description: ExoMars Trace Gas Orbiter science data in the PSA, including CaSSIS colour/stereo images at ~4.5 m/px, NOMAD and ACS atmospheric spectrometers, and FREND neutron data. CaSSIS images are PDS4.

sources.name: Giotto and Huygens data (PSA)
sources.description: Legacy ESA data in the PSA: Giotto Halley Multicolour Camera images of comet 1P/Halley (1986) and the Huygens probe DISR images and spectra from Titan's surface (2005).

sources.name: JUICE data (PSA)
sources.description: Archive area for ESA's Jupiter Icy Moons Explorer. Holds cruise and calibration data such as the Lunar-Earth flyby (August 2024); Jupiter arrival is planned for 2031.

sources.name: Mars Express MARSIS, SPICAM, PFS, VMC (PSA)
sources.description: Other Mars Express instrument data in the PSA: MARSIS subsurface radar sounder, SPICAM UV spectrometer, PFS Fourier spectrometer and the VMC visual monitoring camera. Select the instrument in the PSA interface.

sources.name: ESA PSA TAP / EPN-TAP service
sources.description: TAP / EPN-TAP endpoint for the Planetary Science Archive, queryable with ADQL from VESPA, TOPCAT or scripts. Returns granule metadata with access URLs for PSA data files.

sources.name: Venus Express data (PSA)
sources.description: Venus Express VIRTIS, VMC and SPICAV data of the Venusian atmosphere in the PSA, including VIRTIS-M/H cubes and VMC UV/visible/NIR images. PDS3/PDS4, open access.

sources.name: ESA Image Archives: Rosetta NAVCAM and OSIRIS browser
sources.description: Browsable gallery of Rosetta NAVCAM and OSIRIS images organised by mission phase and date, with image download. Easier to browse than the PSA directory tree.

sources.name: Europlanet GMAP - Geological Mapping of planetary surfaces
sources.description: Europlanet geological mapping pages: guidance for mapping planetary surfaces plus a repository of published geological and geomorphological maps and GIS templates.

sources.name: VESPA - Virtual European Solar and Planetary Access
sources.description: Europlanet's VO-based portal federating dozens of EPN-TAP data services (images, spectra, maps, profiles, simulations) for planetary science and heliophysics, with ADQL and form queries across all services. Also offers PDAP and a NASA PDS keyword search; no login needed.

sources.name: Intuitive Machines lunar lander image releases (IM-1, IM-2)
sources.description: Odysseus (IM-1, February 2024) and Athena (IM-2, March 2025) lunar-landing missions under NASA's CLPS programme; the company publishes descent and surface images and a news feed. Instrument data from NASA payloads are archived separately in the PDS.

sources.name: IPDA - International Planetary Data Alliance
sources.description: Coordination body of the world's planetary data archives (NASA PDS, ESA PSA, JAXA DARTS, ISRO ISSDC, CNSA, Roscosmos and others) maintaining the PDS4 standard for international use, with pointers to member archives and the IPDA PDS4 registry. Not an imagery source itself.

sources.name: Mars Orbiter Mission long-term archive (MCC, TIS, MSM)
sources.description: Browser for the ISRO Mars Orbiter Mission archive: Mars Colour Camera (MCC) images, Thermal Infrared Imaging Spectrometer (TIS), methane sensor and others, with data for 2014-2020 for registered users.

sources.name: JAXA DARTS - Data ARchives and Transmission System
sources.provider: JAXA Institute of Space and Astronautical Science (ISAS)
sources.description: ISAS/JAXA's public archive of mission science data in astrophysics, solar physics, planetary science and engineering. The planetary section holds SELENE/Kaguya, Hayabusa, Hayabusa2, Akatsuki and Nozomi data; browsing is free and needs no login.

sources.name: Nozomi and BepiColombo Mio data (DARTS)
sources.description: Planetary mission pages at DARTS for Nozomi (Mars, imaging and plasma) and BepiColombo Mio (MMO) data. Mostly field-and-particle science; imagery content is limited.

sources.name: Hayabusa2 sample catalogue (JAXA Curation)
sources.description: JAXA curation site for the Hayabusa and Hayabusa2 returned samples with sample catalogues and photographic/analytical data of the grains, and information for sample requests.

sources.name: Kaguya TC DTM and ortho-mosaic (SLDEM / TC mosaic)
sources.description: Global digital terrain model and ortho-mosaic derived from Kaguya Terrain Camera stereo imaging; also the SLDEM2015 merge with LOLA is distributed through PDS Geosciences. Find the TC map products in the SELENE archive tool.

sources.name: SLIM lunar lander (JAXA)
sources.description: Smart Lander for Investigating Moon: January 2024 pinpoint landing near Shioli crater, with multiband camera (MBC) images of nearby rocks and descent imagery published on the mission pages. Raw data are not in a public archive.

sources.name: PlanetMaps.ru - MIIGAiK planetary atlas and maps
sources.provider: Moscow State University of Geodesy and Cartography (MIIGAiK), MExLab
sources.description: Russian-language site of the MIIGAiK Extraterrestrial Laboratory (MExLab) presenting online versions of its planetary atlases and map products (Moon, Mars, Phobos, Venus, Mercury). Some products derive from Soviet and Russian missions.

sources.name: PLANMAP - Planetary Mapping project
sources.description: Horizon 2020 project producing geologic maps and mapping tools for Mars, Moon, Mercury and others; the site lists the maps, a catalogue and publications. Map data are open.

sources.name: SpaceIL Beresheet lunar lander (Israel)
sources.description: Israel's Beresheet lander reached lunar orbit and attempted landing in April 2019; the site shows mission images including a Moon selfie and the final descent frames. Hebrew/English; no raw archive.

sources.name: SSHADE - Solid Spectroscopy Hosting Architecture of Databases and Expertise
sources.description: European database infrastructure of laboratory spectra (UV to far-IR) of solids relevant to planetary and astrophysical science: ices, minerals, meteorites, organics. Includes tools for searching by material, spectrum type and wavelength; downloads are free.

sources.name: Tianwen-1 / Zhurong data release
sources.description: Tianwen-1 orbiter (HiRIC, MoRIC cameras, spectrometers, radar) and Zhurong rover data (navigation, terrain, multispectral cameras, subsurface radar) of Utopia Planitia, released through the CLPDS Mars section. Public availability of the full data set is only partly documented, so check the portal.

sources.name: Kaguya Terrain Camera analysis-ready data (USGS STAC)
sources.provider: USGS Astrogeology Science Center (Kaguya TC data from JAXA)
sources.description: Kaguya (SELENE) Terrain Camera map-projected mosaics and DTM-based products repackaged as cloud-optimised GeoTIFFs and served from the USGS Astrogeology STAC catalog. Easier to view and stream than the PDS3 originals.

sources.name: APIS - Auroral Planetary Imaging and Spectroscopy
sources.description: Database of HST (and some other) UV and visible auroral images and spectra of Jupiter, Saturn and the Galilean-moon footprints, accessed via EPN-TAP. Mostly calibrated FITS from the MAST archive with added metadata.

sources.name: BDIP - historical planetary images (Pic du Midi)
sources.description: Digitised historical observations and drawings of planets from the Pic du Midi and Meudon observatories, searchable via EPN-TAP. Of interest for long-timescale planetary monitoring.

sources.name: CSA - Comet Simulation/Image Archive (VESPA)
sources.description: EPN-TAP service listing comet image data in the VESPA infrastructure. See the service page for exact content and coverage.

sources.name: GMAP - geological maps (VESPA)
sources.description: EPN-TAP index of planetary geological and geomorphological maps (GMAP/PlanMap) with footprints and links to GIS-ready map files.

sources.name: HRSC level-3 / nadir images (VESPA, FU Berlin)
sources.description: EPN-TAP service exposing the HRSC (Mars Express) level 3 map-projected nadir images produced at FU Berlin, with footprints and download links.

sources.name: HST planetary observations (VESPA)
sources.description: EPN-TAP index of Hubble Space Telescope observations of solar-system bodies, linking to the data in MAST. Useful to find HST imaging and spectroscopy by target.

sources.name: Planetary radio (Cassini RPWS, Juno Waves, NDA) via VESPA
sources.description: EPN-TAP services for radio dynamic spectra of Jupiter and Saturn: Juno/Waves, Cassini RPWS/HFR and Nancay Decameter Array.

sources.name: Lunar, Mars and Mercury crater catalogues (VESPA)
sources.description: EPN-TAP crater catalogues for the Moon, Mars (Robbins/Lagain databases) and Mercury, returning crater locations and sizes.

sources.name: MESSENGER MASCS VNIR spectra (VESPA, DLR)
sources.description: EPN-TAP service for MESSENGER MASCS visible-near-infrared spectra of Mercury's surface, with calibrated reflectance and geometry.

sources.name: NOMAD (Mars) and SOIR (Venus) atmospheric profiles (VESPA)
sources.description: EPN-TAP services from BIRA-IASB: NOMAD (ExoMars TGO) vertical profiles of Mars and SOIR (Venus Express) profiles of Venus's atmosphere.

sources.name: OMEGA cubes and maps (VESPA, IAS)
sources.description: EPN-TAP access to Mars Express OMEGA hyperspectral cubes, with companion service for map-projected products. Provided by IAS (IDOC).

sources.name: VESPA 'planets' ephemeris-based service
sources.description: EPN-TAP service for planetary observations/catalogue of planetary properties in the PADC. See the service page for description.

sources.name: ESA PSA through VESPA
sources.description: VESPA registration of the ESA Planetary Science Archive EPN-TAP service, letting PSA holdings be searched together with other Europlanet services.

sources.name: PVOL - Planetary Virtual Observatory & Laboratory
sources.description: Archive of amateur and professional ground-based images of planetary atmospheres (Jupiter and Saturn in particular), with EPN-TAP access. Images are contributed with calibration metadata.

sources.name: RELAB spectral library (VESPA)
sources.description: EPN-TAP access to the Brown University RELAB reflectance spectral library of meteorites, minerals and soils.

sources.name: SSHADE spectra (VESPA EPN-TAP)
sources.description: EPN-TAP view of the SSHADE laboratory spectral database of solids relevant to planetary science and astrophysics (ices, minerals, organics).

sources.name: Titan CIRS profiles (VESPA)
sources.description: EPN-TAP service for Cassini CIRS-derived atmospheric profiles of Titan.

sources.name: VIRTIS-Rosetta geometry on 67P (VESPA)
sources.description: EPN-TAP service giving geolocated footprints of VIRTIS (Rosetta) observations on the shape model of comet 67P/Churyumov-Gerasimenko.
